labelled_by: Claude-labelled (pass 18, 23 Sep 2026) from the lab transcript; replace with his corrections when an exported report exists.
notes: No ad-free copy exists (bears1.dai.json: no copy smaller than the local one), so there are no INSERTED markers and every region is labelled by reading. The feed says 4,406 s and the lab copy is 4,458 s, so about 52 s may have been stitched in at download time, but which read is not known. 'host' below means voiced by Bert or Tom, not proven to be recorded in.

Both mid-roll breaks cut into a story that resumes right after (the Thai-food story at 10:19 / 12:23, the Bar Rescue riff at 22:58 / 26:52), the usual sign of an ad insertion point. The reads have no hand-off line, so each starts at its first line and ends at the last line of its terms/URL.
BetterHelp contains a personal aside ('look, it's a read, but... Leanne does therapy online') that leads straight back into the offer, so it stays inside the ad.

Mountain Dew (listed sponsor; chapter 'Mountain Dew Sizzle' 34:08-38:01) is a sponsored integration: host set-up, the produced sizzle spot, the required tagline and 'thank you, Mountain Dew'. The mid-line hand-off ('speaking of things with a company') and the banter about the editors and the actor who played the cop are EITHER.
Porosos is Bert and Tom's own vodka: the Honey Deuce conversation that names it is NORMAL; the produced spot after the end theme is SELF_PROMOTION (alt ADVERTISEMENT).

There is no pre-roll and no intro bumper: the episode opens on conversation (the 'Intro' chapter is banter). The theme song at 1:12:48 is the OUTRO. About 8.7 s of theme music between the last sung line (1:13:03) and the Porosos spot (1:13:12) has no words to anchor on, so it sits unlabelled between the two regions; a single cut across both is right.
